SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN ADS A ON B.BRD_NO = A.BRD_NO INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MBR_CD = M.MBR_CD WHERE 1=1
AND B.BRD_TITL_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsTitle} || '%'
AND M.MBR_ID LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsWriter} || '%'
AND A.ADS_STATUS_CODE = #{detailSearch.searchAdsStatusCode}
AND A.ADS_BP LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsBp} || '%'
AND A.ADS_PIC LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsPic} || '%'
AND A.ADS_PIC_TELNO LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.searchAdsPicTelno} || '%'

SELECT B.BRD_NO ,B.BRD_TITL_NM ,B.BRD_CONT ,B.MBR_CD ,M.MBR_ID AS MBR_ID ,B.BRD_PBLS_DTM ,B.BRD_VW_CNT ,A.ADS_ID ,A.BRD_NO AS ADS_BRD_NO ,A.ADS_STATUS_CODE ,A.ADS_BP ,A.ADS_PIC ,A.ADS_PIC_TELNO ,A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_START_DT ,A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_END_DT ,A.ADS_REJECT_MESSAGE FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN ADS A ON B.BRD_NO = A.BRD_NO INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MBR_CD = M.MBR_CD WHERE B.BRD_NO = #{brdNo}

SELECT B.BRD_NO, B.BRD_TITL_NM, B.BRD_CONT, B.MBR_CD, B.BRD_PBLS_DTM, B.BRD_VW_CNT, A.ADS_ID, A.BRD_NO AS ADS_BRD_NO, A.ADS_STATUS_CODE, A.ADS_BP, A.ADS_PIC, A.ADS_PIC_TELNO, A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_START_DT, A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_END_DT FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN ADS A ON B.BRD_NO = A.BRD_NO WHERE A.ADS_STATUS_CODE = '승인' AND A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_START_DT <= SYSDATE AND (A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_END_DT + 1) >= SYSDATE AND B.BRD_DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.ADS_REQ_PBLS_START_DT DESC, B.BRD_NO DESC
